summary: Birkenstock Holding plc filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, furnishing a press release that announces the date for its fiscal third quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is described. The filing is a routine report of an upcoming earnings announcement with no deal terms, board recommendation, or structural changes. It is not a special situation, as it merely provides logistical details for investors. Therefore, the filing does not fall under any special-situations category.
